intro: Asset keys are case-sensitive names of files/links inside each scene, not API keys or index names. Enter exact keys separated by commas. Enter * alone for all advertised assets in each returned scene (including metadata, previews and possibly service links); this does not mean all historical scenes or only raster bands. A key such as data_2 is used only when present. Provider access rules still apply. Downloading does not calculate indices, clip full tiles, or apply reflectance scaling. Scene limits still apply. If * is reported as a missing literal key, update the core SDK in this GIS application’s Python environment and restart the application; updating ArcGIS does not update QGIS.
